title: Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and the Helmholtz Theorem
abstract: arXiv:2609.07620v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The recently proposed Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm has not yet been studied in detail from a thermodynamic point of view; this work aims to fill that gap. We demonstrate how thermodynamical state variables and potentials can be derived and thereby demonstrate that the construction of the algorithm formally represents a microcanonical thermodynamic ensemble. In particular, we demonstrate (analytically and numerically) that the algorithm fulfils the Helmholtz theorem, an alternative formulation of the first law of thermodynamics. Furthermore, we construct a new sampling algorithm that extends the original to lower-dimensional inference problems. Finally, we argue that canonical Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithms are more natural than Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo from the thermodynamic and information-theoretic point of view.

translated_title: 微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛与亥姆霍兹定理
translated_abstract: 最近提出的微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛算法尚未从热力学角度得到详细研究，本工作旨在填补这一空白。我们展示了如何推导出热力学状态变量和势，从而证明该算法的构造在形式上代表了一个微正则热力学系综。特别地，我们通过解析和数值方法证明该算法满足亥姆霍兹定理——这是热力学第一定律的一种替代表述形式。此外，我们构建了一种新的采样算法，将原始算法扩展到了低维推断问题。最后，我们论证了从热力学和信息论的角度来看，正则马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法比微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛算法更为自然。
tldr: 本文从热力学角度证明微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛算法满足亥姆霍兹定理并形式上构成微正则系综，提出了适用于低维推断问题的新采样算法，并论证了正则MCMC算法在热力学和信息论意义上更为自然。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that the Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm satisfies the Helmholtz theorem and formally represents a microcanonical thermodynamic ensemble, constructs a new sampling algorithm extending it to lower-dimensional inference problems, and argues that canonical MCMC algorithms are more natural from thermodynamic and information-theoretic perspectives.
